format: Each row: name; the input as inputHex, or as inputGen in one of two forms: { prefixHex, unitHex, count, suffixHex } (expand: prefix, the unit count times, suffix), or { prefixHex, beforeHex, width, afterHex, sepHex, count, suffixHex } (expand: prefix; then for i from 0 to count - 1 the piece before, i as width zero-padded decimal digits, after, the pieces joined by sep; then suffix); expect. expect.ok true: the text is accepted, and encode(parse(t)) == t (an accepted text is its own canonical form; no second copy of its bytes is stored); digests: sha256(ascii(domain) || 0x00 || bytes), lowercase hex, under aukora.capsule.v1 for every accepted row, under its own domain too for an act row, and under all eight domains of 3.5 for empty-object. expect.ok false: class (a refusal class of 3.3) and at (the byte position of 3.3). A row with presentedUnder { domain, id } is the verdict for these bytes presented under that id (3.6): the raw bytes are hashed and compared first; a mismatch is class CAPSULE_BYTES_MISMATCH with no at and the bytes are not parsed; bytes that match are parsed and may be refused by their class and position. act-* rows carry the shapes of sections 6.2 to 6.5a and 8 (fixed test keys; the signature is a placeholder and is never verified). An act-* row with shape { check, call?, ok, rule? } is also the closed-schema verdict of that check (verdict, row, chain, answer, read, status, rowread, gateInputs with its call, request) on the parsed text; every such text is canonical (expect.ok true): a shape refusal is SCHEMA, never a canon class; rule names are this implementation's. A record-* row carries a whole capsule record (section 4) and shape { check: "record", ok, complete, code?, rule? }: the verifier's verdict, every problem it reports having that code and that rule. A runner ignores row members it does not know (3.8); the runner-unknown-member-* rows carry one, `comment`. Written by gen-vectors.mjs from contract draft 7, without the module; digests by node:crypto.

rows.name: runner-unknown-member-accepted
rows.comment: ruling 1 of draft 7: a runner ignores this member; the row is an ordinary accepted row

rows.name: runner-unknown-member-refused
rows.comment: ruling 1 of draft 7: a runner ignores this member; the row is an ordinary refused row
